description: This file contains unit tests for the reftable read/write functionalities, including buffer handling, table serialization/deserialization, and iterator behaviors in a Git-like reference storage system.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__buffer(void)
methods.description: Tests reading and writing data within a reftable buffer, including adding data, reading sample data, and buffer release.

methods.name: void write_table(char *** names,struct reftable_buf * buf,int N,int block_size,enum reftable_hash hash_id)
methods.description: Creates a serialized reftable buffer with specified number of references and logs, for unit testing.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_buffer_size(void)
methods.description: Tests buffer expansion during log compression with intentionally large entries and non-trivial hashes.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_overflow(void)
methods.description: Tests handling of log record overflow due to size constraints, expecting an error.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_limits(void)
methods.description: Verifies that log writing respects configured limits on update indices.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_read(void)
methods.description: Performs end-to-end testing of writing logs, reading them back, and iterating over references and logs.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_zlib_corruption(void)
methods.description: Simulates corruption in compressed log data and verifies error handling during table reading.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_sequential(void)
methods.description: Checks sequential reading and writing of a sizable table with multiple references.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_write_small_table(void)
methods.description: Ensures small tables are serialized effectively and size constraints are respected.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_api(void)
methods.description: Tests table read API, specifically attempting to access logs with a reference iterator.

methods.name: void t_table_read_write_seek(int index,enum reftable_hash hash_id)
methods.description: Tests seeking specific references within a table at different hash configurations and index positions.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear(void)
methods.description: Invoke seeking references with linear hash approach for a full table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear_sha256(void)
methods.description: Same as previous but with SHA256 hashing.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_index(void)
methods.description: Tests seeking within a table with object index enabled.

methods.name: void t_table_refs_for(int indexed)
methods.description: Generates a set of reference names and hashes, writes them, and checks the retrieval via table iteration.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_no_index(void)
methods.description: Tests reference iteration without object index support.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_obj_index(void)
methods.description: Tests reference iteration with object index support enabled.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_table(void)
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to write an empty table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_min_length(void)
methods.description: Checks that the minimal-length object IDs are correctly written, and the length is calculated properly.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_length(void)
methods.description: Verifies handling of object IDs requiring longer prefix disambiguation.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_key(void)
methods.description: Tests writing an empty key (refname) which should produce an API error.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_key_order(void)
methods.description: Ensures references are written in lexicographical order and handling of duplicate or out-of-order indices.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_multiple_indices(void)
methods.description: Checks multiple references with same update index to see proper indexing and iteration.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_multi_level_index(void)
methods.description: Verifies that multi-level indices are created and navigated correctly.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table_empty(void)
methods.description: Ensure proper response to attempting to open an empty or corrupt table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table(void)
methods.description: Simulates table corruption to verify error detection.

ctags.name: t_table_read_write_seek
ctags.pattern: /^static void t_table_read_write_seek(int index, enum reftable_hash hash_id)$/

ctags.name: write_table
ctags.pattern: /^static void write_table(char ***names, struct reftable_buf *buf, int N,$/
ctags.signature: (char *** names,struct reftable_buf * buf,int N,int block_size,enum reftable_hash hash_id)
